text_block_list.text: Days spent gathering all sorts of data on Cesario, while spending every moment together with her—
Understanding and being understood—such tempestuous days. One day, six months after it all began.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's something I'd like to consult you about.
Could I have some of your time this weekend?
And so, the place I was brought to was—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned briefly before, this is the junior club
where I've been helping out as an assistant coach.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...And the consultation I mentioned
is about her, you see—"
Where Cesario was pointing, a young Umamusume was running freely off the turf, paying no mind to the coach's calls.

text_block_list.name: Club Coach
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, hold on!
No sprinting outside the training grounds!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Question
text_block_list.text:
"So noisy~.
I came here to run, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: She's a girl who joined recently, the type who just runs purely on instinct.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I am an Umamusume myself, so I have a fair understanding
of what the instinct to run feels like."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"However, that girl seems to feel it especially strongly.
The other day, she slipped out of the grounds
and wandered quite far away."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've been talking with the coach about how
we first need to teach her how to run safely, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go back and run on the grounds with Teacher?
Running on the turf is super fun, you know!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Question
text_block_list.text: Huh, no way.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: They won't listen to me...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Since you are an Umamusume Trainer,
I thought you might know of a breakthrough.

Hoping there might be something I could do to help,
I decided to watch over the girl for a while.

Rebelling against orders to stay still,
looking for chances to slip away...
I certainly understand feeling impatient, though.
"Even so, from the look of it, she's clearly ignoring us on purpose—"
In other words, they might have deemed me not worth listening to.
Which means—
choice_data_list: Maybe you should work on your steps

text_block_list.text:
First, foster a relationship of trust.
Help her understand that you are on her side
and only wish for her healthy growth.

"If we do that, they might be more willing
to listen when we explain the rules."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see...
That's quite an observant perspective, very fitting for a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However... building a relationship of trust
is not something that happens overnight.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, her desire to run is strong. If left alone, she might take on even more dangerous challenges...
It seemed she wanted to ensure her physical safety first before gradually nurturing a relationship of trust.

"I understand what you're trying to say. That being said,
if I'm to guide you in racing from here on out—"
choice_data_list: No, I think we should focus on building a relationship first.

text_block_list.text:
Forcing someone into a mold for now
ultimately means repressing them.

The mistrust of thinking "there's no point in speaking up"
could leave a deep, long-lasting impact in the future.
choice_data_list: If I am to continue guiding her going forward...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
......
I see. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I am sorry.
I simply cannot compromise on that sense of speed...!"

"...She isn't just being stubborn.
I can see hesitation beneath her stern expression.
She understands my point."

Even so, her students' safety is likely
something she'd never compromise on. If so—
I came up with just one way to build a relationship of trust quickly.
choice_data_list: She wants to be able to run fast, doesn't she?
She wants to be able to run fast, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes.
choice_data_list: Let me hop on your back and let's run!
Let's carry your dreams on our backs and run!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...My back?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Question
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing, super-duper amazing!
Big sis is suuuper faaaast!!" Auch
Clinging to Cesario's back and catching the wind, the little girl's face was... filled with pure excitement!

"Indeed, the quickest way was
'to clearly display one's racing prowess
and earn their respect.'"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
All right,
then even faster...!

Cesario blazes past at full throttle.
A young Umamusume breaks into a radiant smile, shouting with excitement.

By the time they returned from another lap around the turf,
she had become completely attached to Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's make a promise.
You must listen to what the coach and I say.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Question
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"You can run as much as you want,
just make sure it's on the turf, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Question
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it!
Hey, more importantly, teach me how to run already~!

And on the way home, sighing in relief
as hope for the future began to shine—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
If you'd like, would you want to have dinner together tonight?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's something I need to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you remember dodging the Trainer's
questions before your debut race?"

"I remember it like it was yesterday.
It happened while we were heading to the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing of great concern.
Please do not worry yourself over it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: What you prepared for me back then, Trainer, was far more elaborate than I could have ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I suddenly felt terrified at the sheer amount of effort it would take.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I've ended up dragging someone else
into my own outrageous dream—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "‘I must take responsibility,’ I thought."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I am ashamed to admit that it was only then
that I truly realized the gravity of involving
you in my life for all time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I felt that I had to put in the effort, and at the same time, I knew I must not let anyone perceive what was in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So back then...
I just blurted out an excuse without thinking.

...It finally makes sense now.
Why Cesario was so sensitive to people fussing over her.
Disliking the thought of laying bare what's in their heart—

Did you make sure to rarely
show me a gloomy expression?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry
for causing you discomfort.

Even if she felt responsible, if I were a more dependable
Trainer, she might never have considered
hiding it in the first place.
choice_data_list: No, I'm really sorry for not being more reliable

text_block_list.text:
The moment I became a Trainer, to put it dramatically,
I entrusted my destiny to Cesario.
I am fully prepared.
choice_data_list: From now on, I want you to tell me anything, okay?

text_block_list.text: I swallow my frustration at not having been that way until now and say—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I can tell you anything.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Our current situation is the clearest proof of all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"You know me better than anyone.
I felt that especially strongly today."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
When we discussed her,
you chose a compromise without hesitation, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Seeing through the contradiction instantly—that while I refused to yield, I still wanted to respect your position.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I don't have much experience with that kind of thing,
so it made me feel really happy, and a little tickled—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Lately, I've been thinking about something.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Someday, this person will come to understand everything about me."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ‘That is why there is no point in trying to cover it up.’

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's funny, isn't it?
How giving up can sometimes lighten your heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: To think that being known... could bring such relief.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I feel like
I can tell you anything now."

Looking into those eyes that gazed straight back at me—
what had lain deep in my heart came pouring out.
Anger at myself for doing nothing but singing her praises instead of becoming her support, along with impatience and anxiety.

All those days spent gathering, analyzing, acquiring knowledge, running about,
and constantly facing her head-on—
all to stand beside her, to be of help to her.
Now at last, before I even realized it—
choice_data_list: I wonder... did I manage to stand by your side?
I wonder... was I able to stand by your side?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Geez... What kind of face is that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Of course. From now on and forevermore,
your place is right by my side.
